content:
The 2026 annual spring meeting of the Swiss Mathematical Society will be focussing on "Formalization and Proof Assistants", and will take place at UniDistance Suisse, in Brig (canton Valais), on March 25th-27th:

https://unidistance.ch/evenement/sms-spring-meeting-formalization-and-proof-assistants

This will be a 3-day event with a mixture of talks, coding sprints, etc, and potentially an introductory "Lean for beginners" mini-course if there is sufficient interest.

We encourage all interested participants to fill in the online form to register. Some funding for travel and accommodation is available.
